LBY.note: The platform gives trade information and takes enquiries and complaints; no transaction completed online is stated.

facts.fact: Alwasat reports Libya's Ministry of Economy and Trade launched the National Trade Facilitation Enquiry Point platform (LTFU) after its pilot phase, offering an enquiry and complaints service on obstacles to trade transactions with digital follow-up.

LBY.note: No number of complaints received is given, so no in-service fact.
The platform lists 1,030 standards but names no standards body, issued IT standard or certification.
